sub_site: whole blood (ankylosing spondylitis and healthy controls)

evidence.quote: The samples of participants were obtained from different hospitals in Najaf province
The bacterial 16S rRNA gene's V4 region was amplified and sequenced
we examined additional negative control reaction reads during the same sequencing run and concurrently with the samples shown here
One of these samples (sample NEGF) yielded mappable sequencing data

decontamination.tool: control-based flagging rule (taxa >25% of mean sample level in NEGF need 4x control level); flagged taxa kept with asterisk

evidence.quote: Using this approach, the Lachnospiraceae NK4A136 group and Serratia were identified as possible contaminants, and this information will be incorporated in discussions of these taxa.

notes: Only 16/20 samples PCR-positive. One sequenced negative (NEGF) contained Serratia, Staphylococcus, Neisseria and Lachnospiraceae NK4A136 group; Serratia and NK4A136 flagged as possible contaminants but kept in profile (flagged true). 'Corynebacterium 1' recorded as Corynebacterium. Chryseobacterium only named in Discussion as own finding. Top5 from Control-group percentages in E0033 order.
